titulo: Notify the search engines and check indexing
lead: With the foundation ready, every publication closes with two steps: notify the search engines that the URL exists and, a few days later, check whether it made it into the index. Notifying a broken URL burns trust; not checking leaves an important page forgotten. At the end, you build the dated plan for the whole course.
objetivo: notify IndexNow and Bing only with URLs that return 200, and check indexing in URL Inspection.

aprende.t: Notify only with URLs that return 200

hero_alt: A mail carrier delivers envelopes to a mailbox and checks the clipboard.

nos.detalhe: The page went live or really changed. Put the URLs in a list, one per line, all from the same domain.
The script tests each URL. If any doesn't return 200, it stops and shows you which one. Notifying about a 404 burns the search engine's trust.

IndexNow notifies the participating search engines all at once. Google doesn't participate: for Google, the sitemap and URL Inspection are what count. Bing matters twice: it feeds Copilot and, according to a Seer study (not an OpenAI statement), a good share of what ChatGPT cites.
In Search Console's URL Inspection, you can see whether the page got in, when it was crawled, and which canonical Google chose. If Google's canonical is a different one, go back to lesson 4.
Published, checked for 200, notified, inspected the following week. Key page that didn't get in: internal links, body content, and an indexing request in the dashboard.

secoes.volta: Didn't get in? Go back to the X-ray: canonical, internal link, body content
secoes.legenda: Notifying is cheap; notifying wrongly is expensive. That's why the 200 check comes first.

texto: Create a key of 32 or more hexadecimal characters (numbers and letters from a to f) and publish it at https://seusite.com/[sua-chave].txt, with only the key inside.
It isn't a secret: it's public by design, and it proves the site is yours.

exemplo.texto: The news site's first submission came back 403 SiteVerificationNotCompleted: the key had just been published. Resubmitting after about 4 minutes fixed it.

texto: One URL per line, all from the same domain, only what's new or changed.
Don't resubmit the whole site every time something changes.
Run the script with the key in the INDEXNOW_KEY variable. With BING_API_KEY, it also uses the Bing Webmaster API (optional).
The expected response is HTTP 200 or 202.

exemplo.texto: 09/24/2026: 109 URLs through IndexNow, response 202. 10/02: 90 URLs through Bing and IndexNow, response 200.

texto: A week later, inspect the key URLs in Search Console. Write down the status of each one.
The gsc_inspecionar.py script does the same in batch, but it needs a Google credential; start with the dashboard.

exemplo.texto: On 10/05/2026, 12 of 14 key URLs were indexed; on 10/13, 13 of 14. Only /eventos/ was missing, "unknown to Google".

secoes.sub: Replace what's between < > with your own. The Bing key is optional.

blocos.rot: Terminal · notify (IndexNow, and Bing if you have a key)
blocos.conteudo:
INDEXNOW_KEY=<sua-chave> bash tools/avisar_buscadores.sh urls.txt

# optional, with the Bing Webmaster API key:
INDEXNOW_KEY=<sua-chave> BING_API_KEY=<chave-bing> BING_SITE=https://www.seusite.com/ bash tools/avisar_buscadores.sh urls.txt

blocos.rot: Terminal · batch inspection (template; needs a Google credential)
blocos.conteudo:
# requires authenticated gcloud and GSC_QUOTA_PROJ set
python3 tools/gsc_inspecionar.py sc-domain:seusite.com https://www.seusite.com/pagina/

abas.html:
IndexNow: HTTP 202

If a URL doesn't respond with 200, the script stops before sending:

NÃO 200 (404): https://www.seusite.com/pagina-errada/
corrija as URLs acima antes de avisar

https://www.seusite.com/pagina/
   Enviada e indexada | rastreio 2026-10-13 | canônico Google https://www.seusite.com/pagina/

Status, the date of the last crawl, and the canonical that Google chose.

• Notifying before the deploy finishes: the URL still returns a 404.
  • Waiting for IndexNow to reach Google: Google doesn't take part; use the sitemap and URL Inspection.
  • Promising that IndexNow "gets you into ChatGPT": it notifies search engines, but it doesn't guarantee a citation.

secoes.titulo: Practice: your first notification and your first check
secoes.sub: E2 asks for a few days between notifying and inspecting.

exercicios.texto: Publish your IndexNow key on your site, build the urls.txt file with 3 to 5 URLs, and run avisar_buscadores.sh.
exercicios.pronto: the script responded IndexNow: HTTP 200 or 202 and no URL was rejected for not responding with 200.

exercicios.texto: A week later, inspect your 5 most important URLs in Search Console and fill in the log.
exercicios.pronto: the log has 5 rows with status, crawl date, and Google's canonical; the ones that aren't indexed have a next step.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: Why does the script check for a 200 before notifying?
opcoes: Because notifying a URL that doesn't respond (404) burns the search engine's trust.
perguntas.explica: Only what responds with 200 goes into the notification. If any URL fails, the script stops and shows you which one to fix.

opcoes: No: Google doesn't take part; for Google, the sitemap and URL Inspection are what count.
perguntas.explica: IndexNow notifies Bing and other participants. For Google, submit a sitemap and use URL Inspection in Search Console.

perguntas.p: The first submission came back 403 SiteVerificationNotCompleted. What should you do?
opcoes: Check that the key file responds, then resend after a few minutes.
perguntas.explica: At INEMA, the newly published key returned 403; resending after about 4 minutes fixed it.

perguntas.p: The inspection shows a Google canonical that's different from yours. Where should you go back to?
perguntas.explica: Google chose a different URL as the official one. Check the canonical, sitemap, JSON-LD, and links: somewhere, they disagree.

resultado.titulo: By the end of the course
resultado.texto: Your site, read the way a search engine reads it, verified in both dashboards, with a technical foundation and a routine for notifying and checking.

rolagem_fim.texto: Look, verify, fix the foundation, and notify. Only move up a step when the "done when" of the previous one is true.

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and what I decided

itens.texto: Only notify a URL that returns 200.
IndexNow and Bing for Bing and partners; sitemap and inspection for Google.
Bing matters for Copilot and, per a Seer study, for ChatGPT. A notice is not a guarantee of citation.
